# Phase 1 — Validation Strategy

> Per-phase validation contract for feedback sampling during execution.

---

## Test Infrastructure

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Framework** | Vitest `^5.0.0` for `packages/schema`; Vitest via Angular's `@angular/build:unit-test` builder for `apps/web` |
| **Config file** | none — Wave 0 installs (`packages/schema/vitest.config.ts`; `apps/web/angular.json` `architect.test` generated by `ng new --test-runner=vitest`) |
| **Quick run command** | `pnpm --filter schema test -- <spec>` (schema); `pnpm --filter web test -- --run <spec-file>` (web) |
| **Full suite command** | `pnpm -r test` |
| **Estimated runtime** | ~30 seconds (estimate; confirm after Wave 0) |

---

## Sampling Rate

- **After every task commit:** Run the targeted spec for the task (e.g. `pnpm --filter schema test -- fixture-guard`)
- **After every plan wave:** Run `pnpm -r test`
- **Before `/gsd-verify-work`:** Full suite must be green, plus the manual checklist below
- **Max feedback latency:** 60 seconds

---

- [ ] `apps/web/src/app/testing/` — shared fixtures/harnesses
- [ ] `apps/web/src/app/integration/` — real-IndexedDB integration specs

---

## Manual-Only Verifications

| Behavior | Requirement | Why Manual | Test Instructions |
|----------|-------------|------------|-------------------|
| Deep link served with SPA fallback | OPS-02 | Needs a live Workers runtime | `pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter web exec wrangler dev`; open `/` and `/c/<id>`, both render the app |
| Theme follows OS and override persists | DSGN-01 | Visual | Toggle OS dark/light, confirm the app follows; set manual override, reload, confirm it persists |
| 400px, no horizontal scroll, 44px targets | DSGN-02 | Visual layout | Resize to 400px on every screen; confirm no horizontal scroll and touch targets ≥ 44px |
| Reduced motion disables animation | DSGN-03 | OS setting | Enable OS "reduce motion"; confirm transitions and animations stop |
